metricDefinitions.absentBattle: CSV fields for unstarted battles, including finalBossHp, are empty; JSON keeps only actually started battles.
metricDefinitions.actionAttempts: All attempted actions, including rejected actions and exceptions.
metricDefinitions.effectiveLoss: max(0, beforeHP) - max(0, afterHP), summed within battles.
metricDefinitions.enemyAttacks: Sum of per-action enemyAttacksExecuted deltas; announced but unexecuted intents excluded.
metricDefinitions.finalChallengeState: Controller phase and final validated battle, without the opaque Symbol identity; diagnostic outcome is recorded separately.
metricDefinitions.playerActions: Accepted player actions; upgrades excluded. Accepted invalid outputs remain counted but are excluded from validated damage totals.
metricDefinitions.rawLoss: beforeHP - afterHP, summed within battles; negative final HP retained.
metricDefinitions.startedBattles: All actually started battles, including a final defeat, timeout or error.
metricDefinitions.timeout: After execution.maxActionsPerBattle accepted actions in one battle, only if still ongoing. A terminal final allowed action retains victory/defeat. Full mode requires 200.

summary.reason: Still ongoing after 200 accepted player actions
Still ongoing after 200 accepted player actions

strategyDefinitions.B: Heavy when energy >= heavy cost; otherwise attack.
strategyDefinitions.C: Charge when energy < current energyCap; otherwise heavy.
strategyDefinitions.D: Defend only when the announced attack is lethal and defense leaves HP > 0; otherwise B. Armor is included; no player-first-kill prediction.
strategyDefinitions.E: Defend when energy < heavy cost and intent is non-null; otherwise B.
strategyDefinitions.F: Attack if lethal (including Blade); else affordable heavy if lethal (including Blade); otherwise B.
